title: Frog Snake Turtle Song
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat between cue and confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D frogs-snakes-turtles storybook, friendly rounded reptiles and amphibians, simple pond-and-log setting

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 distinguishes amphibians, snakes, turtles, crocodilians and lizards with visible clues; dangerous species are picture-only observations.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses one to two beats of recall and group-specific picture gestures: frogs hop and show webbed feet or eyes; newts and salamanders show tail-swim or external gills; snakes use S-curves plus hood, rattle, or coil when relevant; turtles show shell; crocodilians show armored back and tail; lizards show toe pads, frill, horns, casque, spiny tail, scales, or long tail. Dangerous animals remain hands-off and picture-only.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a muted shaker hiss-shape and marimba step after the word, never a realistic snake hiss bed.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a muted shaker hiss-shape and marimba step after the word, never a realistic snake hiss bed
